caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, brown wooden chest with a curved lid and a central metal latch. On the upper part of the chest’s front face, there is a decorative painted pattern featuring two large, red-orange flowers surrounded by green leaves and stylized green and yellow wave-like motifs. The background of the chest is dark brown, while the flowers and foliage are set against a pale, off-white or light green painted area. The handle on top is a simple, circular metal ring. The hinges and edges of the chest are outlined with dark brown, and there are horizontal yellow-green lines on the lower front panel. The chest sits against a plain, beige background, and there is a small signature in red at the lower right-hand corner reading “M. Schramm.”
title: Box with Lid
